# Summary statistics
## Per metric mean and SD (pipeline performance) 
Per dataset, per data type (mock, sim, clinical) and across datasets for all (numerical) variables in stats_dataset 
```{r sumall, eval=FALSE}

summarise_metrics <- function(df_list,
                              datatypes = list(Mock = mocks, Simulation = sims, Real = reals),
                              exclude_pipelines = c("Expected", "LotuS2_otu")) {

  # 1. One long table: dataset × pipeline × metric
  long <- lapply(names(df_list), function(d) {
    df_list[[d]] %>%
      filter(!pipeline %in% exclude_pipelines) %>%
      select(pipeline, where(is.numeric)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-pipeline, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
      mutate(dataset = d)
  }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    filter(!is.na(value), is.finite(value)) %>%
    mutate(datatype = case_when(dataset %in% datatypes$Mock ~ "Mock",
                                dataset %in% datatypes$Simulation ~ "Simulation",
                                dataset %in% datatypes$Real ~ "Real"))

  metric_stats <- function(x, ...) {
    x %>%
      group_by(metric, ...) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value), .groups = "drop")
  }

  # 2. Mean + SD per dataset, per datatype and across all datasets (across pipelines, NAs excluded)
  bind_rows(
    metric_stats(long, group = dataset)  %>% mutate(level = "dataset"),
    metric_stats(long, group = datatype) %>% mutate(level = "datatype"),
    metric_stats(long) %>% mutate(level = "all", group = "all")
  ) %>%
    mutate(level = factor(level, levels = c("dataset", "datatype", "all")),
           group = factor(group, levels = c(names(df_list), "Mock", "Simulation", "Real", "all")),
           metric = factor(metric, levels = unique(long$metric))) %>%
    arrange(metric, level, group) %>%
    select(metric, level, group, n, mean, sd)
}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))
metric_summary <- summarise_metrics(stats_dataset)

# Wide version: one row per metric, columns <group>_mean / <group>_sd
metric_summary_wide <- metric_summary %>%
  select(-level, -n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = c(mean, sd), names_glue = "{group}_{.value}",
              names_vary = "slowest")

write_tsv(metric_summary_wide, paste0(output_path, "metric_summary.tsv"))


```

## Per metric mean and SD (classifier / reference) 
```{r stat_classify, eval=FALSE}

# mean and SD across pipelines within each dataset, then averaged over datasets 
two_step_summary <- function(df, value_cols, group_cols) {
  df %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_cols, "dataset")))) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(value_cols),
                     list(mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
}

ranks      <- c("phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus")
reasons    <- c("na1", "na2", "partial", "mismatch")
exclude_pl <- c("LotuS2_otu", "Expected")

concordance <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "concordance_taxonomy.rds"))$concordance %>%
  filter(!pipeline %in% exclude_pl) %>%
  mutate(comparison = case_when(
    comb %in% c("def_q2", "def_idtaxa")           ~ "Default vs. harmonized",
    comb %in% c("q2_idtaxa", "q2.gg_idtaxa.gg")   ~ "Q2-NBC vs. IDTAXA (same reference)",
    comb %in% c("q2_q2.gg", "idtaxa_idtaxa.gg")   ~ "SILVA vs. Greengenes2 (same classifier)"))

# Concordance per taxonomic level, per comparison
conc_by_comb <- two_step_summary(concordance, ranks, c("comparison", "comb"))
print(data.frame(conc_by_comb))

write_tsv(conc_by_comb, paste0(output_path, "classifier_concordance.tsv"))

# Genus-level concordance, averaged within each comparison (same classifier-different ref vs different classifier-same ref)
conc_by_comparison <- conc_by_comb %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop")

conc_by_comparison %>% select(comparison, genus_mean, genus_sd) %>% print()

# Reasons for genus-level discordance (proportion of discordant ASVs)
# >> na1 = first classifier unassigned, na2 = second unassigned,
# >> partial = one label contained in the other, mismatch = different genus

mismatch <- two_step_summary(concordance, reasons, c("comparison", "comb"))
write_tsv(conc_by_comb, paste0(output_path, "classifier_mismatch.tsv"))

mismatch %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  print()

```

```{r fig3, eval=FALSE}
df_sub <- lapply(datasets$datasets, function(d) {
  vars <- c("pipeline", "asv")
  if (d %in% reals) {
    vars <- c(vars, "distave_jaccard_asv249", "cor_clr_asv249")
  } else {
    vars <- c(vars, "distexp_jaccard_asv_exp", "cor_clr_exp_asv")
  }

  tmp <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(all_of(vars)) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = d)

  colnames(tmp) <- c("pipeline", "asv", "dist", "cor", "dataset")
  tmp$dist <- 1 - tmp$dist # convert to similarity
  return(tmp)
}) %>% bind_rows()

        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    ylim(c(0,1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)), limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(x = "", y=titles_var[[var]], title = titles_var[[var]]) +
    guides(fill = "none", color = "none")

}

# Plot FP abundances
fps <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "abundance_distributions.rds"))

tit_lev <- c("asv" = "ASV-level", "q2" = "Genus-level (q2)", "idtaxa" = "Genus-level (IDTAXA)")
lev <- "asv"

# False positives
df_fp <- lapply(c(mocks, sims), function(d) {
  fps[[d]][[lev]] %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(spec = ifelse(tp %in% "TP", "True Positive", "False Positive")) %>%
  select(-c(tp, specific)) %>% 
  filter(dataset %in% c(mocks, sims)) %>% 
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets, labels = titles_d))  

df_spec <- lapply(c(reals), function(d) {
  fps[[d]][[lev]] %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(spec = ifelse(specific == 1, "Specific", "Shared")) %>%
  select(-c(tp, specific)) %>% 
  filter(dataset %in% reals) %>% 
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets, labels = titles_d))  

df_comb <- rbind(df_fp, df_spec) %>%
  mutate(spec = factor(spec, levels = c("True Positive", "False Positive", "Shared", "Specific"))) %>% 
  mutate(tp = ifelse(spec %in% c("True Positive", "Shared"), "TP / Shared", "FP / Specific")) %>%
  mutate(tp = factor(tp, levels = c("TP / Shared", "FP / Specific"))) %>%
  mutate(dtype = ifelse(dataset %in% c(mocks, sims), "Ground truth", "Consensus"))

pos <- c("True Positive" = 1, "False Positive" = 1.80, 
         "Shared"        = 3, "Specific"       = 3.80) 

df_comb <- rbind(df_fp, df_spec) %>%
  mutate(
    xpos = pos[as.character(spec)],
    tp   = factor(ifelse(spec %in% c("True Positive", "Shared"), "TP / Shared", "FP / Specific"),
                  levels = c("TP / Shared", "FP / Specific"))
  )

p3 <- ggplot(df_comb, aes(x = xpos, y = ab, group = spec, fill = tp, color = tp)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outliers = FALSE, coef = Inf, width = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos,
                     labels = c("True positive", "False positive", "Shared (2+ pipelines)", "Specific (1 pipeline)"),
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  annotate("text", x = c(1.425, 3.425), y = Inf, vjust = 1.1, size = 2.4,family = "Montserrat Light",
         label = c("Ground truth", "Consensus")) +
  my_theme(theme_classic) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.05)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log10(relative abundance)", title = "Abundance") +
  guides(fill = "none", color = "none")

p4 <- ggplot(df_comb, aes(x = xpos, y = prev, group = spec, fill = tp, color = tp)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outliers = FALSE, coef = Inf, width = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos,
                     labels = c("True positive", "False positive", "Shared", "Specific"),
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  annotate("text", x = c(1.425, 3.425), y = Inf, vjust = 1.1, size = 2.4, family = "Montserrat Light",
         label = c("Ground truth", "Consensus")) +
  my_theme(theme_classic) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.05)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log10(prevalence)", title = "Prevalence") +
  guides(fill = "none", color = "none")

p34 <- p3 + p4 +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "none")
 
# Combine
```

```{r fig5, eval=FALSE}
            vars <- c(vars, paste0("distave_jaccard_", lev), paste0("cor_clr_", lev))
        } else {
            vars <- c(vars, paste0("distexp_jaccard_", lev), paste0("cor_clr_exp_", lev))
        }

        tmp <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(all_of(vars)) %>% 
            mutate(dataset = d)

        colnames(tmp) <- c("pipeline", "genus", "dist", "cor", "dataset")
        tmp$dist <- 1 - tmp$dist # convert to similarity
        return(tmp)
    }) %>% bind_rows() 
    
    df_var <- df_sub %>%
        add_row(data.frame(dataset = "mock5", pipeline = "Expected", genus = 18)) %>%
        add_row(data.frame(dataset = "miseq_v4_sim", pipeline = "Expected", genus = 282)) %>%
        mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, pipelines_l)) %>%
        mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, level = datasets$datasets))
      
    df_sub2 <- df_var %>% 
      mutate(dtype = ifelse(dataset %in% mocks, "Genus Count: Mock", "Genus Count: Simulation / Real"),
            exp = ifelse(dataset %in% reals, "Consensus", "Expected")) %>%
            filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu")

    hlines <- tibble::tribble(
      ~dtype,   ~yintercept, ~color,              ~lt,

      "Genus Count: Mock",   15,          cols_d[["mock12"]],  "dotted",
      "Genus Count: Simulation / Real",    282,         cols_d[["miseq_v4_sim"]],    "dashed",
      "Genus Count: Simulation / Real",    282,         cols_d[["novaseq_v4_sim"]],  "dotted"
    )

    p1 <- df_sub2 %>%

                  position = position_dodge(0.9),
                  color ="#D3D3D3", fill="#D3D3D3") +
      geom_line(aes(group = dataset, color = dataset)) +
      geom_point(aes(fill = dataset, color = dataset, shape = exp), size = 1.5) +
      facet_wrap(~dtype, scales="free") +

        data = hlines,
        aes(yintercept = yintercept, color = I(color), linetype = lt),
        linewidth = 0.3,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) + 
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.05)
      ) +
      guides(fill = "none", color = "none", shape = "none", linetype = "none") +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
      labs(x = "", y = "# genera")

  df_avg <- df_sub2 %>% 
    group_by(dataset) %>% 
    summarize(avg = mean(genus, na.rm=TRUE)) 

  df_dev <- df_avg %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(., df_sub2 %>% filter(!pipeline %in% c("LotuS2_otu", "Expected")), by = "dataset") %>% 
      mutate(perc_diff = (genus - avg) / avg) %>% 
      mutate(exp = ifelse(dataset %in% reals, "Consensus", "Expected"))
  
  tmp <- df_dev %>% mutate(perc_diff = perc_diff * 100) %>% group_by(dataset) %>% summarize(mean_diff = mean(abs(perc_diff), na.rm=TRUE))
  tmp %>% print()
  tmp %>% summarize(mean = mean(mean_diff, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% data.frame()  %>% print()

  df_dev %>% group_by(pipeline) %>% mutate(perc_diff = perc_diff * 100) %>% summarize(mean_diff = mean(perc_diff))

  p2 <- df_dev %>% 
    filter(!pipeline %in% c("Expected","LotuS2_otu")) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets)) %>%
    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = perc_diff)) +
      stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), fill = "#D3D3D3", color = "#D3D3D3") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
      geom_point(aes(color=dataset, fill=dataset, shape=exp), size=1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
      labs(x = "", y = "% difference", title="Deviation from dataset mean (%)") +
      guides(fill = "none", color= "none")
      
  #  Jaccard and Correlation (average)
  titles_var <- c("dist" = "Jaccard Similarity",
                  "cor" = "Union Correlation")

  ylab_var <- c("dist" = "Jaccard Similarity",
                  "cor" = "r")

  df_sub <- df_sub %>% 
      filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>% 
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))

  for (var in c("dist", "cor")) {
  
      if (var %in% "dist") {
          df_sub2 <- df_sub %>%  filter(dataset %in% reals) 
      } else {
          df_sub2 <- df_sub
      }
      
      df_var <- df_sub2 %>% 
          select(!genus) %>% 
          filter(!pipeline %in% c("LotuS2_otu", "eDNAFlow")) %>% 
          mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c(datasets$datasets))) %>%
          mutate(dtype = case_when(dataset %in% reals ~ "Consensus",
                                  TRUE ~ "Ground-truth"))

      pltlist[[paste0("avg_", var)]] <- ggplot(data=df_var, aes(x = pipeline, y = .data[[var]])) +
          stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", alpha = 0.5, position = position_dodge(0.9), color ="#D3D3D3", fill="#D3D3D3") +
          geom_point(aes(fill = dataset, color = dataset, shape = dtype), size = 1.5) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
          scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) + 
          scale_shape_manual(values = c("Consensus" = 16, "Ground-truth" = 17)) + 
          my_theme(theme_classic) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
              panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.05),
              plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
          scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)), limits = c(0, 1)) +
          labs(x = "", y=ylab_var[[var]], title = titles_var[[var]]) 
  }

  #  Jaccard and Correlation (corplot)    
  # Pairwise Jaccard Similarity 
  mat <- distlist[["jaccard"]][["genus"]][["mindset"]][[lev]] %>% as.matrix()
  mat <- 1 - mat # convert to similarity
  colnames(mat) <- rownames(mat) <- pipelines_l[colnames(mat)]

  mat <- mat %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    filter(!rownames(.) %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
    select(-LotuS2_otu) 
  
  pltlist[["avg_dist_pairs"]]  <- mat %>%
      ggcorrplot(., method = "square", type = "lower", lab = FALSE) +
      geom_text(aes(Var1, Var2, label = round(value, 1)), 
              family = "montserrat", size = 5/2.8) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(limit = c(0,1), low = "white", high = "red",
          name = "Jaccard") +

          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
          axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black"),
          axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black"),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
      labs(title = "Jaccard Similarity (MINDSet)")

  # Pairwise Correlation Similarity

  d <- "mindset"

  colnames(cormat) <- rownames(cormat) <- pipelines_l[colnames(cormat)]

  cormat <- cormat %>%

          axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black"),

  # Recall / precision 
  df_sub3 <- lapply(c(mocks, sims), function(d) {

          mutate(dataset = d)

  }) %>% bind_rows() %>%

  titles_var <- c("recallrate" = "Recall ",

  pos <- c("True Positive" = 1, "False Positive" = 1.80, 
          "Shared"        = 3, "Specific"       = 3.80) 

  df_comb <- rbind(df_fp, df_spec) %>%
    mutate(
      xpos = pos[as.character(spec)],
      tp   = factor(ifelse(spec %in% c("True Positive", "Shared"), "TP / Shared", "FP / Specific"),
                    levels = c("TP / Shared", "FP / Specific"))
    )

  p3 <- ggplot(df_comb, aes(x = xpos, y = ab, group = spec, fill = tp, color = tp)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outliers = FALSE, coef = Inf, width = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos,

                legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
                legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
                legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))

    ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "Figure5_", lev, ".pdf"), plot =  combined, device = cairo_pdf, width = 12, height = 10)

}
```

```{r fig5_picrust, eval=FALSE}
        filter(!rownames(.) %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
        select(-LotuS2_otu) 
    }

    pltlist[["avg_dist_pairs"]]  <- mat %>%
        ggcorrplot(., method = "square", type = "lower", lab = FALSE) +
        geom_text(aes(Var1, Var2, label = round(value, 1)), 
                family = "montserrat", size = 5/2.8) +
        scale_fill_gradient2(limit = c(0,1), low = "white", high = "red",
            name = "Jaccard") +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        theme(
            axis.title.x = element_blank(),
            axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
            axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black"),
            axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black"),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
        labs(title = "Jaccard Similarity (MINDSet)")

    # Pairwise Correlation Similarity 
    c <- lev
    d <- "mindset"
    myfile <- paste0(output_path, "cor_list", c, "_", d, ".rds")
    cormat <- readRDS(file = myfile)[["avg_corr"]][["all"]][[d]][[c]][["clr"]]
    colnames(cormat) <- rownames(cormat) <- pipelines_l[colnames(cormat)]

    if ("LotuS2_otu" %in% rownames(cormat)) {
        cormat <- cormat %>% 
            as.data.frame() %>% 
            filter(!rownames(.) %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
            select(-LotuS2_otu) 
    }
    
    pltlist[["avg_cor_pairs"]]  <- cormat %>%
        ggcorrplot(., method = "square", type = "lower", lab = FALSE) +
        geom_text(aes(Var1, Var2, label = round(value, 1)), 
                family = "montserrat", size = 5/2.8) +
        scale_fill_gradient2(limit = c(0,1), low = "white", high = "red",
            name = "Correlation") +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        theme(
            axis.title.x = element_blank(),
            axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
            axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black"),
            axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black"),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
        labs(title = "Union Correlation (MINDSet)")

    # Recall / precision 
    df_sub3 <- lapply(sims, function(d) {
        tmp <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(pipeline, paste0("recall_", lev), paste0("precision_", lev)) %>% 
            mutate(dataset = d)
        colnames(tmp) <- c("pipeline", "recallrate", "precisionrate", "dataset")
        return(tmp)
    }) %>% bind_rows() %>%
        filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
        mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets),
               pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))

    ## Scatter plot for miseq + smt else? 
    titles_var <- c("recallrate" = "Recall",
                    "precisionrate" = "Precision")

    for (var in c("recallrate", "precisionrate")) {
        df_var <- df_sub3 %>% 
            mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets)) %>%
            filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu")

        pltlist[[paste0("avg_", var)]] <-  ggplot(df_var, aes(x = pipeline, y = .data[[var]])) +
            stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", alpha = 0.5, position = position_dodge(0.9), color ="#D3D3D3", fill="#D3D3D3") +
            geom_point(aes(fill = dataset, color = dataset), shape = 17,
                    size = 1.5) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
            scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) + 
            my_theme(theme_classic) +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.05),
                plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
            ylim(c(0,1)) +
            scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)), limits = c(0, NA)) +
            labs(x = "", y=titles_var[[var]], title = titles_var[[var]]) +
            guides(fill = "none", color = "none")

    }

    # Scatterplot 
    df_sub4 <- lapply(names(stats_sample[["miseq_v4_sim"]])[!names(stats_sample[["miseq_v4_sim"]]) %in% "LotuS2_otu"], function(p) {
        tmp <- stats_sample[["miseq_v4_sim"]][[p]] %>% 
            dplyr::select(paste0("recall_", lev), paste0("precision_", lev)) %>% 
            mutate(pipeline = p)
        colnames(tmp) <- c("recallrate", "precisionrate", "pipeline")
        return(tmp)
    }) %>% bind_rows() %>%
        filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
        mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l)) %>%
        slice_sample(prop = 1) 

    pltlist[["scatter"]] <- df_sub4 %>% 
        ggplot(., aes(x = recallrate, y = precisionrate, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
        geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.7) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p, drop=FALSE) +
        scale_color_manual(values = cols_p, drop=FALSE) +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        labs(y = "Precision", x = "Recall", title = "Recall and Precision (Simulation (MiSeq))") + 
        xlim(c(0, 1)) +
        ylim(c(0, 1)) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) +
        guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
        theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
                panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05))   

    # Combine 
    r1 <- p1 | p2
    r2 <- (pltlist[["avg_recallrate"]] | pltlist[["avg_precisionrate"]] | pltlist[["scatter"]] ) +
        plot_layout(widths = c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3)) +
        theme(axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)))
    r3 <- (pltlist[["avg_dist"]] | pltlist[["avg_dist_pairs"]] | pltlist[["avg_cor"]] | pltlist[["avg_cor_pairs"]]) +
        plot_layout(widths = c(0.225, 0.275, 0.225, 0.275))

    combined <- (r1 / r2 / r3) + 
            plot_layout(heights = c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3),
                        guides = "collect") &
            theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
                legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
                legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))

    ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "Figure5_", lev, ".pdf"), plot =  combined, device = cairo_pdf, width = 12, height = 10)
}
```

### Figure 6: Statistical Evaluation 
```{r fig6, eval=FALSE}

# Three rows
# 1) Effect sizes alpa (observed vs shannon) and beta div (3 panels; A-C)
# 2) Effect sizes DA + p-values DA + Overlap matrix 
# 3) Association consistency (real data) + recall / precision (sim data)

p_thres <- 0.05

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))
da_cor <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "da_corstats.rds"))
da_propsig <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "da_probsig.rds"))
allmods <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "alpha_models_lm.rds"))
allperm <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "group_permanova.rds"))

df_stat <- lapply(c(sims, reals), function(d) {
  allmods[[d]]$mods %>% 
    select(pipeline, est, alpha, p) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c(sims, reals))) %>%
  filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu")

ave_exp <- df_stat %>% 
  filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>% 
  group_by(dataset, alpha) %>% 
  summarize(ave_est = mean(est, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(exp_est = NA) %>%
  mutate(dtype = case_when(dataset %in% reals ~ "Real",
                           dataset %in% sims ~ "Simulation")) 

for (d in sims) {
  for (a in unique(ave_exp$alpha)) {
    exp_est <- df_stat %>% 
      filter(dataset %in% d, alpha %in% a, pipeline %in% "Expected") %>%
      pull(est)

    ave_exp$ave_est[ave_exp$dataset %in% d & ave_exp$alpha %in% a] <- exp_est
  }
}  

p1 <- df_stat %>% 
  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l)) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = alpha, y = est)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="solid") +
  geom_point(size = 1, position = position_dodge(0.6), aes(color = dataset, fill = dataset, group=dataset)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
  geom_point(data = ave_exp, aes(x = alpha, y = ave_est, shape = dtype, group = dataset),
             position = position_dodge(0.6), color = "black", size = 2, alpha=1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Real" = 16, "Simulation" = 17)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("observed_richness" = "Observed", 
                              "shannon_diversity" = "Shannon")) +
  my_theme(theme_classic) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Beta Coefficient", title = "Alpha Diversity") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  ylim(-0.5, 0.5)

df_sub <- df_stat %>% 
  filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., ave_exp, by = c("alpha", "dataset")) %>%
  mutate(diff_ave = est - ave_est) 
  
newlabs <- c("observed_richness"="Observed Richness",
             "shannon_diversity"="Shannon Diversity")

p2 <- df_sub %>% 
  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l)) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, color = dataset, fill = dataset)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0) +
    geom_line(aes(group = dataset, y = diff_ave, linetype = dtype), alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, aes(y = diff_ave, shape = dtype)) +   
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Real" = 16, "Simulation" = 17)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Real" = "solid", "Simulation" = "dashed")) +
    facet_wrap(~alpha, nrow = 2, labeller = as_labeller(newlabs)) +
    my_theme(theme_bw) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1),
          panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()) +
    ylim(c(-0.4,0.4)) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Δ Beta coefficient",title =  "Deviation From Average/Expected Effect") +
    guides(fill = "none", color = "none")

  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("jaccard" = "Jaccard", 
                              "aitchison" = "Aitchison")) +
  my_theme(theme_classic) +
  labs(x = "", y = "R2", title = "Beta Diversity") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)), limits = c(0, 0.03)) 

df_sub <- df_beta %>% 
  filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., ave_exp_beta, by = c("dist", "dataset")) %>%
  mutate(diff_ave = R2 - ave_r2,
         diff_exp = R2 - exp_r2) %>% 
  # mutate(diff = ave_r2 - R2) 
  mutate(dist = factor(dist, levels = c("jaccard", "aitchison")))

newlabs <- c("jaccard"="Jaccard Dissimilarity",
             "aitchison"="Aitchison Dissimilarity")

p4 <- df_sub %>% 
  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l)) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = diff, color = dataset, fill = dataset)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0) + 
    geom_line(aes(group = dataset, y = diff_ave, linetype = dtype), alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, aes(y = diff_ave, shape = dtype)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Real" = 16, "Simulation" = 17)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Real" = "solid", "Simulation" = "dashed")) +
    facet_wrap(~dist, nrow = 2, labeller = as_labeller(newlabs)) +
    my_theme(theme_bw) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1),
          panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()) +
    ylim(c(-0.015,0.015)) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Δ R2", title = "Deviation From Average/Expected Effect") +
    guides(fill = "none", color = "none")

# Row 2 (Differential abundance)
df_ngen <- lapply(c(sims, reals), function(d) {

tmp %>% summarize(mean = mean(mean_diff, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% data.frame()  %>% print()

# Proportion significant
df_prop <- lapply(c(sims, reals), function(d) {
  stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
    select(pipeline, da_sig100_q2, da_sig7599_q2, da_sig5074_q2, da_sig2549_q2, da_sig024_q2) %>%

  mutate(propsig_cat = propsig_cat %>%
                        str_remove("da_") %>% 
                        str_remove("_q2")) %>% 
  mutate(propsig_cat = factor(propsig_cat, levels = c("sig100", "sig7599", "sig5074", "sig2549", "sig024"),
                                           labels = c("100%", "75-99%", "50-74%", "25-49%", "<25%"))) %>%
  mutate(dtype = case_when(dataset %in% sims ~ "Simulation",
                           TRUE ~ "Real")) %>%
  mutate(dtype = factor(dtype, levels = c("Simulation", "Real")))

  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines))

# Precision / recall
df_sub <- lapply(sims, function(d) {
  stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(pipeline, da_recall_q2, da_precision_q2) %>%
  mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu")

plts <- lapply(c("da_recall_q2", "da_precision_q2"), function(var) { 
  if (grepl("recall", var)) {
    ylab <- "Recall"
    mytitle <- "DA Recall"
  } else {
     ylab <- "Precision"
     mytitle <- "DA Precision"
  }
  
  df_sub %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l)) %>% 
    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = .data[[var]])) +
      stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", alpha = 0.5, position = position_dodge(0.9), color ="#D3D3D3", fill="#D3D3D3") +
      geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 1, position = position_dodge(0.5), shape=17,
                aes(fill = dataset, color = dataset)) + 
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
            panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) +
      labs(x = "", y = ylab, title = mytitle) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.05)), limits=c(NA, 1)) +
      guides(fill = "none", color = "none")
})

# Combine 
r1 <- (p1 | p2| p3 | p4) +
      plot_layout(widths = c(0.15, 0.35, 0.15, 0.35))
r2 <- (p5 | plts[[1]] | plts[[2]])
r3 <- (p7  | p6 | p8 | p9) +
      plot_layout(widths = c(0.28, 0.28, 0.28, 0.16))

combined <- (r1 / r2 / r3) +
      plot_layout(heights = c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3),
                          guides = "collect") &
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
            legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
            legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
            legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))

ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "Figure6.pdf"), plot = combined, device = cairo_pdf, width = 10, height = 9)
```

```{r fig7, eval=FALSE}
# Heatmap per feature category
df_feat2 <- df_all %>% 
  filter(!grepl("recall|precision", variable)) %>% 
  mutate(metric_base = variable %>% 
           str_remove("_q2$")) %>% 
  # Average across avs and genus level 
  mutate(metric_base = metric_base %>% 
           str_remove("_asv$")) %>% 
  group_by(pipeline, dataset, metric_base) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # remove ave/exp extensions
  mutate(metric_base = metric_base %>%
           str_remove("_exp$") %>%
           str_remove("_ave$")) %>%
  # Average across alpha metrics (shannon, observed) and across beta metrics (aitchison, jaccard)
  mutate(metric_base = metric_base %>%
          str_replace("_alpha_shannon", "_alpha") %>%
          str_replace("_alpha_observed", "_alpha") %>%
          str_replace("_beta_jaccard", "_beta") %>%
          str_replace("_beta_aitchison", "_beta")) %>%
  group_by(pipeline, dataset, metric_base) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Create variable type identifier
  mutate(vtype = sapply(str_split(metric_base, "_"), head, 1)) %>%
  group_by(pipeline, dataset, vtype) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

## Supplementary Figures 
### Sequencing depth
 
This figure shows the sequencing depth prior to (input) compared to after pipeline processing across cohorts 
```{r seq_depth_plt, eval=FALSE}

stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))
pltlist <- list()
df_comb <- list()

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  df <- stats_sample[[d]][[3]]
  df_comb[[d]] <- data.frame(pipeline = character(), reads_out=numeric())

  for (p in pipelines) {
    if (is.null(stats_sample[[d]][[p]])) next
    df2 <- stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% select(reads_out) %>% mutate(pipeline = p)

    df_comb[[d]] <- df_comb[[d]] %>%
      add_row(df2 %>% select(reads_out) %>% mutate(pipeline = p)) 
  
  }

  df_comb[[d]] <- df_comb[[d]] %>% 
    bind_rows(data.frame(pipeline = "Input", reads_out=df$reads_in)) %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = c("Input", pipelines), labels = c("Input", pipelines_l)))

  pltlist[["reads_out"]][[d]] <- ggplot(data = df_comb[[d]], aes(x = pipeline, y = reads_out, fill=pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Input" = "black", cols_p)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Input" = "black", cols_p)) +
    my_theme(theme_classic) +
    labs(title = titles_d[[d]], y = "# reads") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid.major.x=element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1),
          plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5))

}

combined <- wrap_plots(pltlist$reads_out, ncol=4, nrow=2) +
            plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
                    theme(legend.position = "none",
                    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
                    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
                    legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                    legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))

ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "SFigure_reads.pdf"), 
      plot = combined, device = cairo_pdf, width = 10, height = 5)
```

```{r suppl_fig_descstat, eval=FALSE} 
            stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% 
              select(sample_names, reads_lost) %>%
              mutate(pipeline = p)

          mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines),

}) %>% bind_rows()
```

```{r other_stats2, eval=FALSE}
stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall.rds"))
rl <- read_tsv(read_length_all, col_names=TRUE) # Read lengths for plotting

pltlist <- list()

for (d in datasets$datasets) {

  df_sample <- lapply(names(stats_sample[[d]]), function(p) {
      stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% select(sample_names, reads_lost) %>%
                                 mutate(pipeline = p)
  }) %>% bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines))

  plt <- df_sample %>%
    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = reads_lost, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) 

  if (!d %in% mocks) {
    plt <- plt + 
      # geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, width = 2.2) +
      geom_boxplot(linewidth=0.2, outlier.size=0.1, alpha = 0.7) + #+ color = "black"
      guides(color = "none", fill = "none")
      # geom_jitter(shape = 21, size = 0.02, width = 0.05, alpha = 0.3)
  } else {
    plt <- plt + 
      geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) 
  }

  pltlist[["readslost"]][[d]] <- plt + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +   
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +  
    my_theme(theme_classic) + 
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(y = "",
         x = "",
         title = titles_d[d]) +
    ylim(c(0, 100))

  # Sparsity
  if(!d %in% reals) {
    tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds"))

    df_dataset <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
      select(pipeline, sparsity) %>%
      add_row(pipeline = "Expected", sparsity = sum(assay(tse_exp) == 0) / (nrow(tse_exp)*ncol(tse_exp)) * 100) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = c(pipelines)))
  } else {
    df_dataset <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
      select(pipeline, sparsity) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines))
  }
  
  pltlist[["sparsity"]][[d]] <- ggplot(df_dataset, aes(x = pipeline, y = sparsity, fill = ifelse(pipeline == "Expected", "Expected", "Pipeline"))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("Expected" = "#A6A6A6",
                  "Pipeline" = "#D3D3D3"),
        breaks = c("Expected", "Pipeline")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = df_dataset$sparsity[df_dataset$pipeline == "Expected"], linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
    my_theme(theme_classic) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(y = "",
         x = "") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05)) +
    ylim(c(0, 100))

  # Output read length
  pltlist[["readlength"]][[d]] <- rl %>% 
    filter(Dataset %in% d) %>%
    group_by(Pipeline) %>%
    slice_sample(n = 700) %>%
    ungroup() %>%  
    mutate(Pipeline = factor(Pipeline, levels = pipelines)) %>% 
    ggplot(., aes(x = Pipeline, y = Length, fill = Pipeline, color = Pipeline)) +
      # geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, width = 1.5) +
      geom_jitter(shape = 21, size = 0.05, width = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) + 
      my_theme(theme_classic) + 
      theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "none") +
      guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
      labs(y = "", x = "") +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(65, 500)) 
}
```

```{r ave_ab_plt, eval=FALSE}

plt_df <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "abundance_distributions.rds"))

pltlist <- list()
pltlist_tp <- list()

titles <- c("asv" = "ASV",
            "q2" = "q2 (genus)",
            "idtaxa" = "IDTAXA (genus)",
            "def" = "Default (genus)",
            "KO" = "Kegg Orthologs (picrust)",
            "cyc" = "MetaCyc Pathways (picrust)")
i <- 0

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  
  min_d <- 1e-09
  max_d <- 1

  xlim_d <- c(min_d, max_d) # for plotting 

  i <- i + 1

  for (tr in c("asv", "def", "q2", "idtaxa", "KO", "cyc")) {

    noexp <- (d %in% reals) || tr %in% c("def", "KO", "cyc") # no expected abundance info available
    t <- ifelse(i == 1, titles[names(titles) %in% tr], "") # only plot titles for first row of plots 
    x <- ifelse(i == length(datasets$datasets), "log10(relabundance)", "")

    #### Plotting
    # Abundance density plot
    pltlist[[d]][[tr]] <- plt_df[[d]][[tr]] %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = rev(pipelines), labels = rev(pipelines_l))) %>%
      ggplot(., aes(x=ab+1E-20, y = pipeline, color = pipeline, fill = pipeline)) +
        geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.5) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
        scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        scale_x_log10(limits=xlim_d) +
        labs(title = t, y="", x = x) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
                plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

    # Abundance density plot (TP vs FP)
    if (!noexp) {

      min_n <- 5
      x <- ifelse(i == length(mocks)+length(sims), "log10(relabundance)", "")
      
      pltlist_tp[[d]][[tr]] <- plt_df[[d]][[tr]] %>% 
        mutate(tp = factor(ifelse(tp %in% "TP", "TP", "FP"))) %>%
        mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = rev(pipelines), labels = rev(pipelines_l))) %>%
        group_by(pipeline, tp) %>%
        mutate(n_per_group = n(),
               plot_type = ifelse(n_per_group >= min_n, "density", "points")) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        ggplot(., aes(x=ab+1E-20, y = pipeline, color = pipeline, fill = pipeline)) +
          geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.3,
                      scale = 1, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
          geom_point(data = ~subset(.x, plot_type == "points"),
                     size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p, drop=FALSE) +
          scale_color_manual(values = cols_p, drop=FALSE) +
          my_theme(theme_bw) +
          scale_x_log10(x, limits=xlim_d) +
          labs(y = "", title = t) +
          facet_wrap(~tp) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
                plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    }
  }
}
```

### False negative abundances
```{r ab_fn, eval=FALSE}

fps <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "abundance_distributions.rds"))
fns <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "abundance_distributions_fn.rds"))

combined <- list()
tit_lev <- c("asv" = "ASV-level", "q2" = "Genus-level (q2)", "idtaxa" = "Genus-level (IDTAXA)")

for (lev in c("asv", "q2", "idtaxa")) {

  # False negatives 
  df_fn <- fns[[lev]] %>%
    mutate(tp = factor(tp, levels = c("tp", "fn"), labels = c("True Positive", "False Negative"))) %>%
    filter(dataset %in% sims) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets, labels = titles_d))  

  # False positives
  df_fp <- lapply(c(mocks, sims), function(d) {
    fps[[d]][[lev]] %>%
      mutate(dataset = d)
  }) %>% bind_rows() %>% 
    mutate(tp = factor(ifelse(tp %in% "TP", "tp", "fp"), levels = c("tp", "fp"), labels = c("True Positive", "False Positive"))) %>%
    filter(dataset %in% sims) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets, labels = titles_d))  

  # Plot
  tit <- c("ab" = "Abundance", "prev" = "Prevalence")
  pltlist <- list()

  for (o in c("df_fn", "df_fp")) {
    df <- get(o)

    pltlist[[o]] <- lapply(c("ab", "prev"), function(var) { 
      df %>% 
        ggplot(., aes(x = tp, y = .data[[var]])) +
          geom_violin() +
          stat_summary(aes(fill = pipeline, color = pipeline), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
          # geom_point(aes(fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
          facet_wrap(~dataset, ncol=4) +
          scale_y_log10() +
          my_theme(theme_bw) +
          labs(x = "", y = paste("Log",tit[[var]]), title = tit[[var]]) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
                plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) +
          guides(fill = "none", color="none")
    })
  }

  comb <- wrap_plots(pltlist[["df_fn"]], ncol = 2) /
          wrap_plots(pltlist[["df_fp"]], ncol = 2) 

  pdf(NULL)
  comb <- patchworkGrob(comb)
  dev.off()

  combined[[lev]] <- arrangeGrob(comb, 
            left = textGrob(rev(c("False Negative", "False Positive")), 
                    rot = 0, 
                    gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat"),
                    y = seq(0.25, 0.79, length.out = 2),
                    just = "left",
                    x=0.1),
            top = textGrob(tit_lev[[lev]],
                    gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat")))

}

pdf(paste0(plot_path, "SFigure_fnfp_ab", ".pdf"),
    width = 8, height = 6)

for (p in combined) {
  grid.newpage()
  grid.draw(p)
}

dev.off()
```

```{r feat_pipeline, eval=FALSE}
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))
algorithms_df <- read_tsv(algorithms) %>% select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

pltlist <- list()

# ASVs/Genus in mocks + sims 
for (d in c(mocks, sims)) {

  gen_fn <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "genus_fn_tp_", d, ".rds"))

  for (c in classifiers) {

    tse_exp <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_fn_tp_", d, ".rds"))
    count_fn <- sapply(pipelines, function(x) {
      status_col <- paste0("fn_", x)
      if (!status_col %in% colnames(rowData(tse_exp))) return(NA)
      sum(rowData(tse_exp)[[status_col]] == "fn", na.rm = TRUE)
    }) %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline")

    colnames(count_fn) <- c("pipeline", "fn_count") 

    df_tmp <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
      select(pipeline, asv, asv_tp, asv_1mm, num_genus = !!paste0("num_genus_", c), genus_tp = !!paste0("genus_tp_", c)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(count_fn, by = "pipeline")

    df_tmp2 <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(pipeline, perc_tp_precision, perc_1mm_precision, perc_fp)

    gen_fn_sub <- gen_fn[[d]][[c]]
    count_fn <- sapply(pipelines, function(x) {
      status_col <- paste0("fn_", x)
      if (!status_col %in% colnames(gen_fn_sub)) return(NA)
      sum(gen_fn_sub[[status_col]] == "fn", na.rm = TRUE)
    }) %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline")

    colnames(count_fn) <- c("pipeline", "fn_count_genus") 

    df_tmp <- df_tmp %>%
      dplyr::left_join(count_fn, by = "pipeline") 

    if (d %in% "mock5") {
      df_tmp <- df_tmp %>% 
        add_row(pipeline = "Expected", asv = 61, num_genus = 18)
    } else if (d %in% "mock12") {
      df_tmp <- df_tmp %>% 
        add_row(pipeline = "Expected", asv = 61, num_genus = 15)
    } else if (grepl("v4_sim", d)) {
      df_tmp <- df_tmp %>% 
          add_row(pipeline = "Expected", asv = 2191, num_genus = 282)
    }

    df_tmp$pipeline <- factor(df_tmp$pipeline, levels = c(pipelines))

    pltlist[["asv"]][[d]] <- ggplot(df_tmp) +
      geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = asv+fn_count, fill = "False Negative"),
              stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
      geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = asv, fill = ifelse(pipeline == "Expected", "Expected", "False Positive")),
              stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
      geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = asv_1mm, fill = "One Mismatch"),
              stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
      geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = asv_tp, fill = "True Positive"),
              stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = df_tmp$asv[df_tmp$pipeline %in% "Expected"], linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("False Negative" = "#e2e2e2ec",
                  "Expected" = "#A6A6A6", 
                  "False Positive" = "#D39895",
                  "True Positive" = "#9DCB7D",
                  "One Mismatch" = "#C9E2B8"),
        breaks = c("Expected", "False Negative", "False Positive", "True Positive", "One Mismatch")
      ) +
      labs(title = titles_d[d],
          x = "",
          y = "",
          fill = "") +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
      
      for (v in c("primer", "qc", "denoising", "chimera", "merging")) {
        pltlist[["pipeline_stat"]][[v]][[d]] <- df_tmp %>%
          filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>% 
          dplyr::left_join(., algorithms_df, by = "pipeline") %>%
          mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines)) %>%
          ggplot(., aes(x = .data[[v]], y = asv, color = .data[[v]])) +
            geom_jitter(width = 0.1, height=0, size = 3, alpha = 1) +
            labs(title = titles_d[d],
                x = "",
                y = "",
                fill = "") +
            my_theme(theme_classic) +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
                  panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05))
      }

      pltlist[["perc_asv"]][[d]] <- df_tmp2 %>%
        # filter(!pipeline %in% "Natrix") %>%
        mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines)) %>%
        ggplot(.) +
        geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = 100, fill = "False Positive"),
                stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
        geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = perc_tp_precision+perc_1mm_precision, fill = "One Mismatch"),
                stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
        geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = perc_tp_precision, fill = "True Positive"),
                stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = c("False Positive" = "#D39895",
                    "True Positive" = "#9DCB7D", 
                    "One Mismatch" = "#C9E2B8"),
          breaks = c("False Positive", "True Positive", "One Mismatch")) +
        labs(title = d,
            x = "",
            y = "% of total counts",
            fill = "") +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

    pltlist[[c]][[d]]  <- ggplot(df_tmp) +
      geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = num_genus+fn_count_genus, fill = "False Negative"),
              stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
      geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = num_genus, fill = ifelse(pipeline == "Expected", "Expected", "False Positive")),
              stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
      geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = genus_tp, fill = "True Positive"),
              stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = df_tmp$num_genus[df_tmp$pipeline %in% "Expected"], linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("False Negative" = "#e2e2e2ec", 
                  "Expected" = "#A6A6A6", 
                  "False Positive" = "#D39895",
                  "True Positive" = "#9DCB7D",
                  "One Mismatch" = "#C9E2B8"),
        breaks = c("Expected", "False Negative", "False Positive", "True Positive", "One Mismatch")
      ) +
      labs(title = "",
          x = "",
          y = "",
          fill = "Legend") +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      guides(color = "none", fill = "none")
  
  }
}
```

```{r plot_asv_gen_sample, eval=FALSE}

stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))
pltlist_recall <- list()

make_plots <- function(df, suffix, title) {
  vars <- c("recall", "precision")

  plots <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
    col <- paste0(v, suffix)

    plt <- df %>%
      select(pipeline, sample_names, all_of(col)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = pipeline, y = .data[[col]],
                 fill = pipeline, color = pipeline))

    if (length(unique(df$sample_names)) < 5) {
      plt <- plt +
        stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "bar", alpha = 0.3, width = 0.6) +
        geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 0.5)
    } else {
      plt <- plt +
        geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.1)
    }

    plt +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
      ) +
      labs(y = "", title = title, x = "") +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))
  })

  setNames(plots, vars)
}

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  df_sample <- lapply(names(stats_sample[[d]]), function(p) {
      s_list <- c("sample_names", "asv", "num_genus_q2", "num_genus_idtaxa")
      if("num_genus" %in% colnames(stats_sample[[d]][[p]])) s_list <- c(s_list, "num_genus") # For APSCALE
      stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% select(all_of(s_list)) %>%
                                 mutate(pipeline = p)
    }) %>% bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))
    
    # Total ASVs
  for (v in c("asv", "num_genus", "num_genus_q2", "num_genus_idtaxa")) {
    if (length(unique(df_sample$sample_names)) < 5) {
      pltlist_recall[[v]][[d]] <- ggplot(data = df_sample, aes(x = pipeline, y = .data[[v]], fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
        geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, alpha=0.5) +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    } else {
      pltlist_recall[[v]][[d]] <- ggplot(data = df_sample, aes(x = pipeline, y = .data[[v]], fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
        geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) 
    }

    t <- ifelse(v %in% "asv", titles_d[d], "")

    pltlist_recall[[v]][[d]] <- pltlist_recall[[v]][[d]] +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      labs(title = t, x = "", y = "") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5))
  }

  if (d %in% reals) next

  # Recall precision scatter (asv)
  df_sample <- lapply(names(stats_sample[[d]]), function(p) {
      stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% select(sample_names, recallrate, recallrate_1mm,
                                        precisionrate, precisionrate_1mm) %>%
                                mutate(pipeline = p)
    }) %>% bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))

  # Recall perfect match (0mm)
  pltlist_recall[["pr_scatter_asv"]][[d]] <- df_sample %>% 
      slice_sample(prop=1) %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = recallrate, y = precisionrate, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
        # stat_ellipse(alpha = 1, linewidth = 1, type = "t") +
        geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.7) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p, drop=FALSE) +
        scale_color_manual(values = cols_p, drop=FALSE) +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        labs(y = "Precision", x = "Recall", title = titles_d[d]) + 
        xlim(c(0, 1)) +
        ylim(c(0, 1)) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) +
        guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
        theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
              panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05))        

  # recall 1mm (1mm)
  pltlist_recall[["pr_scatter_1mm"]][[d]] <- df_sample %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = recallrate, y = precisionrate, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
        geom_segment(aes(x = recallrate, y = precisionrate, 
                        xend = recallrate_1mm, yend = precisionrate_1mm, 
                        group = sample_names, color = pipeline), alpha = 0.5) +
        geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_point(aes(x = recallrate_1mm, y = precisionrate_1mm,fill = pipeline, color = pipeline), shape = 21, alpha = 0.7) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
        scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        labs(y = "Precision", x = "Recall", title = titles_d[d]) +
        xlim(c(0, 1)) +
        ylim(c(0, 1))


  for (c in classifiers) {

    df_sample <- lapply(names(stats_sample[[d]]), function(p) {
      stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% select(sample_names, recallrate, recallrate_1mm,
                                        precisionrate, precisionrate_1mm,
                                        precision_gen = !!paste0("precision_gen_", c),
                                        recall_gen = !!paste0("recall_gen_", c),
                                        asv, num_gen = !!paste0("num_genus_", c)) %>%
                                 mutate(pipeline = p)
    }) %>% bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))


    # genus
    lstmp <- make_plots(df=df_sample, suffix="_gen", title=c)
    pltlist_recall[["recall_gen"]][[c]][[d]]    <- lstmp[[1]] + ggtitle("")
    pltlist_recall[["precision_gen"]][[c]][[d]] <- lstmp[[2]] + ggtitle("")

    # asv
    lstmp <- make_plots(df=df_sample, suffix="rate", title=titles_d[d])
    pltlist_recall[["recall_asv"]][[d]] <- lstmp[[1]]
    pltlist_recall[["precision_asv"]][[d]] <- lstmp[[2]] + ggtitle("")

    # Scatter genus level
    pltlist_recall[["pr_scatter_gen"]][[c]][[d]] <- df_sample %>% 
        slice_sample(prop=1) %>% # to make point appear in random order (to see all)
        ggplot(., aes(x = recall_gen, y = precision_gen, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
          geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.7, position = position_jitter(width = 0.003, height = 0.003)) + 
          scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p,drop=FALSE) +
          scale_color_manual(values = cols_p, drop=FALSE) +
          my_theme(theme_classic) +
          labs(y = "Precision", x = "Recall", title = "") +
          xlim(c(0, 1)) +
          ylim(c(0, 1)) +
          guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
          theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
                panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05))

  }
}
```

### False and True Positives per pipeline
```{r plot_tp_fp, eval=FALSE}

FP_stats <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "FP_stats_pipelines_datasets.rds"))
TP_mat <- FP_stats$tp_mat
FPs <- FP_stats$FP
FNs <- FP_stats$FN

pltlist <- list()

for (d in c(mocks, sims)) {
  for (c in classifiers) {
    
    if (d %in% mocks) {
      ro <- pipelines[!pipelines %in% c("Expected")]# Not expected
      co <- sort(TP_mat[[d]][[c]]$genus)
    } else {
      ro <- pipelines[!pipelines %in% c("Expected", "eDNAFlow")]# Not expected, not eDNAFlow
      co <- TP_mat[[d]][[c]][-1] %>% rowSums(.)  # column order
      names(co) <- TP_mat[[d]][[c]]$genus
      co <- co %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>% names()
    }

    presence_df <- as.data.frame(TP_mat[[d]][[c]]) %>%
      pivot_longer(-genus, names_to = "pipeline", values_to = "presence")

    presence_df$genus <- factor(presence_df$genus, levels = co)
    presence_df$pipeline <- factor(presence_df$pipeline, levels = ro)

    pltlist[["TP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- ggplot(presence_df, aes(x = pipeline, y = genus, fill = factor(presence))) +
    geom_tile(color = "transparent", alpha = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "#A9D08E"), labels = c("Absent", "Present")) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    my_theme(theme_bw) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Presence")) +
    labs(title = titles_d[d], x = "", y = "") +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

    if (d %in% sims) {
      pltlist[["TP_mat"]][[c]][[d]]  <- pltlist[["TP_mat"]][[c]][[d]]  + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
    }

    if (c %in% "idtaxa") {
      pltlist[["TP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- pltlist[["TP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] + ggtitle("")
    }

    # Plot FPs across pipelines
    fp_count <- FPs %>% filter(dataset == d, classifier == c) %>% group_by(genus) %>% summarize(n = n())
    ord <- fp_count %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(genus)
    fp_count$genus <- factor(fp_count$genus, levels = ord)

    pltlist[["FP_count"]][[c]][[d]] <- ggplot(fp_count, aes(x = genus, y = n)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#B1D3DE") +
      # geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
      labs(title = "", x = "Genus", y = "Count") +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(x) unique(floor(pretty(seq(min(x), (max(x) + 1) * 1.1)))))

    pltlist[["FP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- FPs %>%
      filter(dataset == d, classifier == c) %>%
      mutate(presence = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = fp_count %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(genus))) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = ro)) %>%
      ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = genus, fill = presence)) +
      geom_tile(color = "transparent", alpha = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D39895", "white"), labels = c("False Positive", "Absent")) +
      scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      my_theme(theme_bw) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = titles_d[d], x = "", y = "") +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "False Positive")) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

    if (c %in% "idtaxa") {
      pltlist[["FP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- pltlist[["FP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] + ggtitle("")
    }
  
    fn_count <- FNs %>% filter(dataset == d, classifier == c) %>% group_by(genus) %>% summarize(n = n())
    ord <- fn_count %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(genus)
    fn_count$genus <- factor(fn_count$genus, levels = ord)

     pltlist[["FN_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- FNs %>%
      filter(dataset == d, classifier == c) %>%
      mutate(presence = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = fn_count %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(genus))) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = ro)) %>%
      ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = genus, fill = presence)) +
      geom_tile(color = "transparent", alpha = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#adadad55", "white"), labels = c("False Negative", "Absent")) +
      scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      my_theme(theme_bw) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = titles_d[d], x = "", y = "") +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "False Negative")) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))


    if (d %in% sims) {
      pltlist[["FN_mat"]][[c]][[d]]  <- pltlist[["FN_mat"]][[c]][[d]]  + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
    }

    if (c %in% "idtaxa") {
      pltlist[["FN_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- pltlist[["FN_mat"]][[c]][[d]] + ggtitle("")
    }

  }
}

pdf(NULL)
pages <- lapply(c("TP_mat", "FP_mat"), function(p) {
```

#### Correlation (union vs intersection)
```{r corall_union, eval=FALSE}

find_cols <- function(data, patterns) {
  Reduce(function(cols, pat) cols[grepl(pat, cols)], patterns, init = colnames(data))
}

label_cor <- function(variable) {
  factor(ifelse(grepl("intersection", variable), "intersection", "union"),
         levels = c("union", "intersection"))
}

feat_levels <- c("asv", "deftax", "q2", "idtaxa", "KO", "cyc")
feat_labels <- c("ASV", "Pipeline Default", "Q2-NBC", "IDTAXA", "KO", "MetaCyc")

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))

### Correlations

df_exp <- lapply(c(mocks, sims), function(d) {
  vars <- find_cols(stats_dataset[[d]], c("cor", "clr", "exp"))
  vars <- vars[!grepl("part", vars)]

  stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
    select(pipeline, all_of(vars)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(pipeline, dataset), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(exp  = "expected",
         feat = sapply(str_split(variable, "_"), tail, 1),
         cor  = label_cor(variable)) %>%
  filter(!feat %in% "gg") %>%
  mutate(feat = factor(feat, levels = feat_levels, labels = feat_labels))

df_real <- lapply(reals, function(d) {
  vars <- find_cols(stats_dataset[[d]], c("cor", "clr"))
  vars <- vars[!grepl("asv$", vars)]
  vars <- vars[!grepl("part", vars)]

  tmp <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
    select(pipeline, all_of(vars)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)

  colnames(tmp) <- gsub("249", "", colnames(tmp))
  tmp
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(pipeline, dataset), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(exp  = "consensus",
         feat = sapply(str_split(variable, "_"), tail, 1),
         cor  = label_cor(variable)) %>%
  filter(!feat %in% "gg") %>%
  mutate(feat = factor(feat, levels = feat_levels, labels = feat_labels))

df <- bind_rows(df_exp, df_real) %>%
  filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets))

p1 <- df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cor, y = value, color = dataset, shape = exp)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.05, color = "black") +
    geom_line(aes(group = interaction(dataset, pipeline)),
              linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~feat) +
    my_theme(theme_bw) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) +
    labs(x = "", y = "r")
```

### Taxonomic mismatch reasons 
> NA in one of the classifiers (na1 = first classifier, na2 = second classifier)
> Partial match (substring match, eg prevotella and prevotella_9)
> Complete mismatch  
```{r mismatch_reason, eval=FALSE}

alloverlaps <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "concordance_taxonomy.rds"))
concordance <- alloverlaps$concordance
pages <- list()

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  conc_sub <- concordance %>%
    filter(dataset %in% d) %>% 
    mutate(concordant = genus,
           discordant = 1 - genus,
           na1 = na1 * discordant,
           na2 = na2 * discordant,
           partial = partial * discordant,
           mismatch = mismatch * discordant) %>%
    select(comb, pipeline, concordant, na1, na2, partial, mismatch) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(concordant, na1, na2, partial, mismatch), 
                 names_to = "category", 
                 values_to = "percentage") %>%
    mutate(category = factor(category, levels = rev(c("concordant", "partial", "mismatch", "na2", "na1")))) %>%
    mutate(comb = factor(comb, levels = c("def_q2", "def_idtaxa", "q2_idtaxa",
                                            "def_q2.gg", "def_idtaxa.gg", "q2.gg_idtaxa.gg",
                                            "q2_q2.gg", "idtaxa_idtaxa.gg"), 
                                labels = c("Default vs. Q2-NBC", "Default vs. IDTAXA", "Q2-NBC vs. IDTAXA",
                                           "Default vs. Q2-NBC (gg)", "Default vs. IDTAXA (gg)", "Q2-NBC (gg) vs. IDTAXA (gg)",
                                           "Q2-NBC (silva) vs. Q2-NBC (gg)", "IDTAXA (silva) vs. IDTAXA(gg)"))) %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))

  plt <- conc_sub %>%
    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = percentage, fill = category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    facet_wrap(~comb, ncol=3, nrow=4) +
    my_theme(theme_bw) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(x = "") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("concordant" = "#9DCB7D",
                                    "partial" = "#C9E2B8",
                                    "na1" = "#c7c7c7d2",
                                    "na2" = "#929292ff",
                                    "mismatch" = "#D39895")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,
                       limits = c(0, 1.02), 
                       expand = c(0, 0)) 
  
  pdf(NULL)
  pages[[d]] <- arrangeGrob(plt, 
                            top = textGrob(titles_d[[d]],
                            gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat")),
                            left = textGrob(rev(c("Default vs. Q2-NBC/IDTAXA (silva)", "Default vs. Q2-NBC/IDTAXA (gg)","Silva vs GreenGenes")), 
                            rot = 0, 
                            gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat"),
                            y = seq(0.2, 0.80, length.out = 3),
                            just = "left",
                            x=0.1))

p_sum <- concordance %>%

                      labels = c("Default vs. Q2-NBC", "Default vs. IDTAXA", "Q2-NBC vs. IDTAXA"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(dataset, pipeline, comb), names_to = "category", values_to = "percentage") %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = c("mismatch", "partial", "na1", "na2"),
                                     labels = c("Complete mismatch", "Partial match", "NA in classifier 1", "NA in classifier 2"))) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = comb, y = percentage, fill = category, color = category)) +
    # stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", position = "dodge") +
```

## Statistical Evaluation
### Alpha Diversity 
#### Alpha diversity group comparisons 
```{r plot_alpha, eval=FALSE}

pltlist <- list()
alpha_mods <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "alpha_models_lm.rds")) 

for (d in c(sims, reals)) {

  tmp <- alpha_mods[[d]][["meta"]] %>% 
    filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))

  # Plot alpha distribution per dataset
  pltlist[["all"]][[d]] <- tmp %>% 
    ggplot(., aes(x=diversity, y = pipeline, color = pipeline, fill = pipeline)) +
      geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.5, linewidth=1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(Expected = "#A6A6A6"), cols_p) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
      my_theme(theme_bw) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
      guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
      facet_wrap(~index, scales="free_x") +
      labs(x = "", y = "")  
  
  if (!d %in% "mindset") {
    # Density plot for categorical variable
    pltlist[["groups"]][[d]] <- tmp %>% 
      ggplot(., aes(x=diversity, y = pipeline, color = label)) +
        geom_density_ridges(alpha=0, linewidth=0.5) +
        my_theme(theme_bw) +
        # scale_fill_manual(values = cols_cs) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("#81cdd4ff", "#263434ff")) +
        labs(x = "", y = "", title = titles_d[[d]]) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
        facet_wrap(~index, scales = "free_x")  
  } else {
    # Scatter plot for continuous variable
    pltlist[["groups"]][[d]] <- alpha_mods[[d]][["meta"]] %>% 
      ggplot(., aes(x=RC1, y = diversity, color = pipeline)) +
        geom_point(size= 1, alpha = 0.6) +
        my_theme(theme_bw) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
        scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
        labs(x = "Negative Valence", y = "diversity", title = titles_d[[d]]) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
        facet_wrap(~index, scales = "free_y", nrow=2) +
        guides(color = "none", fill = "none") 
  }   

  pltlist[["stats"]][[d]] <- alpha_mods[[d]][["mods"]] %>%
    filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = rev(pipelines), labels = rev(pipelines_l)),
           alpha = factor(alpha, levels = c("observed_richness", "shannon_diversity"), 
                                 labels = c("Observed Richness", "Shannon Diversity")),
           sig = p < 0.05) %>% 
    ggplot(., aes(y = pipeline, x = est)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CIl, xmax = CIh, color = col, alpha = p<0.05), 
                        height = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = col, alpha = p<0.05), size = 3, shape = 18, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(exp="#A6A6A6",
                                    obs="#7abd75ff",
                                    shan="#f7bd00ff")) +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.5)) +
      my_theme(theme_bw) +
      facet_wrap(~alpha) +
      xlim(-0.65, 0.65) +
      guides(color = "none") +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
      labs(x = "Regression coefficient", y = "", title = titles_d[[d]])
}
```

### Filtering thresholds
#### Ground-truth metrics 
```{r filt_sim, eval=FALSE}

prev_df <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings.rds"))
prev_df$filttype[prev_df$filttype %in% "short_seq"] <- "short"
prev_df$filttype[prev_df$filttype %in% "long_seq"] <- "long"
colnames(prev_df)[colnames(prev_df) %in% "precicion"] <- "precision"

pltlist <- list()
pages <- list()
titles <- c("precision" = "Precision",
            "recall" = "Recall",
            "jaccard" = "Jaccard",
            "cor" = "CLR correlation")

df_nofilt <- lapply(reals, function(d) {
  readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings_real_", d, "_nofilt", ".rds")) %>%
  mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() 

for (filt in c("prev", "count", "short", "long")) {
  
  filt_df <- lapply(reals, function(d) {
    readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings_real_", d, "_", filt, ".rds")) %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)
  }) %>% bind_rows() 

  tmp <- df_nofilt
  tmp$filttype <- filt
  if (filt %in% c("prev", "count")) {
    tmp$threshold[tmp$filttype %in% filt] <- 1
  } else {
    tmp$threshold[tmp$filttype %in% filt] <- 0
  }

  filt_df <- filt_df %>% 
    bind_rows(tmp) 
    
  for (var in c("precision", "recall", "jaccard", "cor")) {
    
    if (var %in% c("precision", "recall")) { 
      tmp <- prev_df %>% 
        filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
        filter(filttype %in% filt) %>% 
        mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))
    } else {
      tmp <- filt_df %>% 
        filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
        mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))        
    }

    for (cs in c("cols_p", "cols_d")) {

      if (cs %in% "cols_p") {
        f <- "pipeline"
      } else {
        f <- "dataset"
      }

      pltlist[[cs]][[filt]][[var]] <- tmp %>% 
            ggplot(., aes(x = factor(threshold), y = .data[[var]])) +
              geom_line(aes(group = interaction(pipeline,dataset), fill = .data[[f]], color = .data[[f]])) +
              geom_point(aes(fill = .data[[f]], color = .data[[f]])) +
              scale_color_manual(values = get(cs)) +
              scale_fill_manual(values = get(cs)) +
              my_theme(theme_classic) +
              theme(legend.position="right",
                    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
                    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05)) +
              coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
              # theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 40, 5, 5)) +
              # guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
              labs(x = ifelse(filt %in% "count", "threshold (>=)", ""),
                  title = ifelse(filt %in% "prev", titles[names(titles) %in% var], "")) +
              theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + 
              ylim(c(0,1))
    }

  }
}

for (cs in c("cols_p", "cols_d")) {
  plt <- wrap_plots(pltlist[[cs]][["prev"]], ncol = 4) /
         wrap_plots(pltlist[[cs]][["count"]], ncol = 4) /
         wrap_plots(pltlist[[cs]][["short"]], ncol = 4) /
         wrap_plots(pltlist[[cs]][["long"]], ncol = 4) +
          plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
          theme(legend.position = "right",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))

  pdf(NULL)
  g <- patchworkGrob(plt)
  dev.off()

  pages[[cs]] <- arrangeGrob(g, 
              left = textGrob(rev(c("Prevalence", "Counts", "Short Sequences", "Long Sequences")), 
                      rot = 0,

}
```
