```{r filt_perc_change, eval=FALSE}

titles <- c("precision" = "Precision",
            "recall" = "Recall",
            "jaccard" = "Jaccard",
            "cor" = "CLR correlation")

prev_df <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings.rds"))
prev_df$filttype[prev_df$filttype %in% "short_seq"] <- "short"
prev_df$filttype[prev_df$filttype %in% "long_seq"] <- "long"
colnames(prev_df)[colnames(prev_df) %in% "precicion"] <- "precision"


##### % improvement / deterioration sim
p_change <- data.frame(pipeline = character(),
                        dataset = character(),
                        filt = character(),
                        var = character(),
                        perc_change = numeric())

for (d in c(sims, reals)) {
  for (filt in c("prev", "count", "short", "long")) {

    df_nofilt <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings_real_", d, "_nofilt", ".rds"))
    filt_df <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings_real_", d, "_", filt, ".rds"))

    df_nofilt$filttype <- filt
    if (filt %in% c("prev", "count")) {
      df_nofilt$threshold[df_nofilt$filttype %in% filt] <- 1
    } else {
      df_nofilt$threshold[df_nofilt$filttype %in% filt] <- 0
    }

    filt_df <- filt_df %>% 
      bind_rows(df_nofilt)
        
    for (var in c("precision", "recall", "jaccard", "cor")) {

      if (d %in% reals & var %in% c("precision", "recall")) next
      if (d %in% sims & var %in% c("jaccard", "cor")) next

      print(paste(d, filt, var))
      
      if (var %in% c("precision", "recall")) { 
        tmp <- prev_df %>% 
          filter(dataset %in% d) %>%
          filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
          filter(filttype %in% filt) %>% 
          mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))
      } else {
        tmp <- filt_df %>%
          filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
          mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))        
      }
     
      
      nofilt_threshold <- ifelse(filt %in% c("prev", "count"), 1, 0)
      
      nofilt <- tmp %>% 
        filter(dataset %in% d) %>% 
        filter(filttype == filt, threshold == nofilt_threshold) %>%
        select(pipeline, .data[[var]])

   
      t <- case_when(filt %in% c("short", "long") ~ 1,
                     filt %in% "prev" ~ 2,
                     filt %in% "count" ~ 3)

      prev_sub <- tmp %>% 
        filter(dataset %in% d) %>% 
        filter(filttype %in% filt) %>% 
        filter(threshold == t) %>% 
        select(pipeline, .data[[var]]) 

      percentage <- prev_sub %>%
        dplyr::left_join(nofilt %>% select(pipeline, nofilt = .data[[var]]), by = "pipeline") %>%
        mutate(perc_change = (.data[[var]] - nofilt) / nofilt * 100) %>%
        select(pipeline, perc_change) %>%
        mutate(dataset = d, filt = filt, var = var)

      p_change <- p_change %>%
        bind_rows(percentage) 

    }
  }
}

p_change <- p_change %>%
  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines_l)) %>%
  mutate(var = factor(var, levels = c("precision", "recall", "jaccard", "cor"), 
                           labels = c("Precision", "Recall", "Jaccard", "Correlation"))) %>%
  mutate(filt = factor(filt, levels = c("prev", "count", "short", "long"),
                             labels = c("Prevalence (>=2)", "Counts (>=3)", "Short seq. (<=240)", "Long seq. (>=260)")))

p1 <- p_change %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = filt, y = perc_change)) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), color ="#606568ff", fill="#606568ff") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    geom_point(size = 1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), aes(color=dataset, fill=dataset)) + 
    # geom_line(aes(group = interaction(dataset,pipeline)), color = dataset, linewidth = 0.1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    my_theme(theme_bw) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_d)  +
    facet_wrap(~var, ncol=2) +
    guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
                             limits = c(-50, 250), 
                             expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(x = "", y = "% change", title = "Effect of ASV-level filtering")

ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "SFigure_filtering_percchange.pdf"), plot = p1, device = cairo_pdf, width = 5, height = 5)

```

Compare LotuS2 in ASV and OTU mode 
```{r LotuS2, eval=FALSE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))

# Feature-level ground truth
df_ground <- lapply(c(mocks, sims), function(d) {
  stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(pipeline, recall_asv=recallrate, recall_q2=recallrate_genus_q2, precision_q2=precisionrate_genus_q2, precision_asv=precisionrate, 
                                          cor_clr_exp_asv, cor_clr_exp_q2) %>% 
      mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() 

df_consensus <- lapply(reals, function(d) {
  stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(pipeline, jaccard_asv=distave_jaccard_asv249, jaccard_q2=distave_jaccard_q2, cor_clr_asv, cor_clr_q2, da_cor_q2=da_corest_ave_q2, da_jaccard_q2=da_jaccard_ave_q2) %>% 
      mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() 

df_sim <- lapply(sims, function(d) {
  stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(pipeline, da_cor_exp_q2=da_corest_exp_q2, da_recall_q2, da_precision_q2) %>% 
      mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Create complete df
df <- df_ground %>% 
  dplyr::full_join(df_consensus, by = c("pipeline", "dataset")) %>% 
  dplyr::full_join(df_sim, by = c("pipeline", "dataset")) %>% 
  filter(pipeline %in% c("LotuS2", "LotuS2_otu"))

df_long <- df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols=-c(pipeline, dataset), values_to = "value", names_to = "variable") %>% 
  mutate(variable = variable %>% str_remove("_exp")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
  mutate(feat = case_when(grepl("asv", variable) ~ "asv", 
                          grepl("q2", variable) ~ "genus")) %>%
  mutate(variable = variable %>% str_remove("_asv") %>% str_remove("_q2")) %>% 
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c("asv", "recall", "precision", "jaccard", "cor_clr", "da_recall", "da_precision", "da_jaccard", "da_cor"),
                                      labels = c("ASV", "Recall", "Precision", "Jaccard", "Correlation", "DA Recall", "DA Precision", "DA Jaccard", "DA Correlation"))) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets)) %>% 
  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = c("LotuS2", "LotuS2_otu"), labels = c("LotuS2 (ASV)", "LotuS2 (OTU)")))

p1 <- df_long %>%
  filter(!variable %in% "asv") %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = variable, y = value, group = interaction(variable, pipeline))) +
        geom_hline(yintercept=0) + 
        geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(variable, pipeline), 
                         fill = pipeline),
                     outliers = FALSE, 
                     position = position_dodge(0.9), alpha = 0.5) + 
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("LotuS2 (ASV)" = "#77b2cfff", "LotuS2 (OTU)" = "#6f7274ff")) +
        geom_point(aes(color = dataset), 
                   position = position_dodge(0.9),
                   shape = 19,
                   size = 1) +
        scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) +
        my_theme(theme_bw) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
        labs(x = "", y = "metric")

ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "SFigure_LotuS2.pdf"), plot = p1, device = cairo_pdf, width = 6, height = 4)

lapply(datasets$datasets, function(d) {
  stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(pipeline, asv) %>% 
    filter(pipeline %in% c("LotuS2", "LotuS2_otu")) %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pipeline, values_from = asv)
```

```{r mock_filter, eval=FALSE}
c <- "q2"
d <- "mock5"
sample <- "Even1"

tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "_genus_exp_allpipelines.rds"))
tse_sub <- tse[, tse$sample %in% sample]
tse_sub <- tse_sub[, !tse_sub$pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu"]
colnames(tse_sub) <- gsub(paste0("_", sample), "", colnames(tse_sub))

exp_gen <- rownames(tse_sub)[assay(tse_sub[, colnames(tse_sub) %in% "Expected"]) > 0]
gen_renamed <- lapply(rowData(tse)$genus, function(x) {
    if (x %in% exp_gen) {
        x
    } else {
        "Other"
    }
})

rowData(tse_sub)$genus_sub <- as.character(gen_renamed)
tse_sub2 <- agglomerateByVariable(tse_sub, by = "rows", f = "genus_sub")

df <- data.frame(assay(tse_sub2, "relabundance")) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "genus") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -genus, names_to = "pipeline", values_to="abundance") %>%
  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))

n_colors <- length(unique(df$genus))
paired_extended <- rev(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(n_colors))
paired_extended <- setNames(paired_extended, unique(df$genus))

  ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = abundance, fill = genus)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", position = "stack", alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = paired_extended) +
    my_theme(theme_classic) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
```
